naselja: Boundaries of the settlements of Bilje Municipality.
institucije: Municipal offices and the institutions and company it owns.
ulice: Streets from the register of spatial units.
katastar: Cadastral parcel boundaries and numbers, visible when zoomed in.
javni_sadrzaji: Pharmacies, doctors, kindergartens, schools, shops, playgrounds, sports, recycling, post, ATMs…
slobodno_vrijeme: Restaurants, cafés, accommodation, viewpoints, parks, castles and monuments.
pristupacnost: Whether public buildings can be entered with a wheelchair or pram.
imovina_opcine: Real estate owned by Bilje Municipality.
komunalna: Local roads, green areas, car parks, cemeteries and other infrastructure.
plinovod: Route of the main gas pipeline.
groblja: Extent of drone images of cemeteries.
groblja_dron: Detailed drone image of cemeteries, visible when zoomed in.
grobna_mjesta_prijedlog: Grave outlines automatically detected on drone images – working draft.
projekti: Development projects under the municipal strategy to 2030.
projekti_baza: Completed, ongoing and planned municipal projects.
gradevinska_podrucja: Building zones under the 2017 spatial plan – not current.
osjetljivost_solar: Where solar farms would least affect nature.
osjetljivost_vjetar: Nature sensitivity for wind farms (birds, bats, habitats).
pogodnost_solar: Technical suitability of land for solar farms.
corine_1980: Land cover in 1980 – compare with 2018 using the swipe tool.
corine_promjene: Where land cover changed between 2012 and 2018.
izgradenost_promjena: New built-up areas from Copernicus satellite data.
bonitet: Agricultural value of land (spatial plan classes).
pedoloska_karta: Soil types from the basic soil map.
arkod_uporaba: Registered agricultural parcels by land use (no farmer data).
paprika_pogodnost: Where conditions for paprika are best.
tlo_org_ugljik: Organic carbon in topsoil – an indicator of soil health.
stanje_usjeva: Is the crop stronger or weaker than in previous years – per parcel.
kulture_satelit: What was grown on each parcel this season – estimate.
zone_parcela: Parts of parcels that are consistently weaker or stronger.
poplave_vv: Frequently flooded areas; colour shows water depth.
poplave_mv: Rare, extreme floods; colour shows water depth.
nasipi: Flood embankments along the Drava and the Danube.
hidro_postaje: Water level stations on the Drava and the Danube.
jezera_bare: Lakes (Kopačko jezero, Sakadaš), ponds and river islands.
sanitarna_zastita: Protection zones of drinking water sources.
prepreke_vodotoci: Sluices, pumping stations, groynes and weirs.
zasticena_podrucja: Areas protected under the Nature Protection Act.
natura_povs: Natura 2000 sites important for species and habitats.
lovista: Hunting ground boundaries – useful for walkers in hunting season.
pokrov_zemljista: Settlements, fields, forests, wetlands and water.
ramsar: Kopački rit – wetland of international importance.
rezervat_biosfere: Transboundary biosphere reserve along the Mura, Drava and Danube.
upravljacke_zone: Zones from protected area management plans.
obnova_prirode: Areas and measures proposed for nature restoration.
posjetitelji_tocke: Attractions, visitor centres, information boards, birdwatching, fishing, restaurants.
posjetitelji_linije: Cycling routes, educational trails and boardwalks.
bastina_registar: Protected cultural heritage areas: Tikveš castle, Zlatna Greda.
tocke_gledista: Points from which views were assessed.
osjetljivost_krajobraza: How sensitive the landscape is to new development.
toponimi_rgi: Names of fields, ponds, river arms and forests from the official register.
doprinosi: Old photographs and local place names contributed by residents.
odvoz_otpada: When waste is collected in your street.
mobilno_reciklazno: Where and when the mobile recycling yard comes.
kvaliteta_zraka: Kopački rit, Osijek 1 and Osijek 2 stations – latest hourly values.
dogadjanja: Festivals, sport, culture, fairs and road closures.
komunalni_objekti: Street lights, benches, bins, playground equipment, defibrillators.
prijave: Problems reported by residents and their status.
